verdict.rationale: Kimi's own docs say users operate Kimi Code Desktop and the CLI through conversation: the agent reads code, edits files, runs commands and completes tasks from chat. The consumer app's entry point is also a natural-language prompt for questions or Agent tasks. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that specifically assesses natural-language control of product operations (community items address model quality rather than this capability).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
